steps.otherKeys: In {g} major and {f} major the fingering is the same as in {c} major: right hand 1 2 3 1 2 3 5, left hand 5 4 2 1 3 2 1. Only the chord changes: {g}, {b} and {d}; {f}, {a} and {c}.
steps.prelude: The opening of Bach’s Prelude in {c} (BWV 846), from 1722: each chord is spread into the same rising figure and played twice. The left hand plays the two lower notes, the right hand the three above. Written here in eighth notes, with a new pedal for each chord.
steps.preludeInTime: Now in time, flowing and even.
